text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay, Kawakami!
Leave it to this genius magical girl, Sweepy!"

Lunch break. I spotted two people messing around
by the side ditch...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Actually... I dropped my precious Pre-Fi pen
inside that grating over there!
Urrgh...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"I'll pick those up with my magic!
You watch, too. Alright, here we go!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"China Aster!"
Lost item! Return to me!
(Dead silence...)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, what gives?!
Why isn't anything happening?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, one more time...!
"Ezogiku Aster"!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez! Why, why, why?! "China Aster! A-S-T-E-R"!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: "Eizo Giku!! As—" *cough!* *cough, cough*...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Sweep-san, you mustn't push yourself! Not allowed!
Your voice will get totally wrecked!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
As a princess,
I cannot cause any more trouble!
I must do something using my own strength—!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shut uuup! I told you I'm going
to save you! Just shut up and watch!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
If that's how it's gonna be... time for my trump card!
You guys, wait right there!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: S-Sweep-san?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting! Now everything's all set!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my, a racing outfit...!
It's a costume change right before battle!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! When princesses and witches transform into special dresses☆, their power surges to the max!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Yes! This outfit is Magical Girl Sweepy's magic item that amplifies my magic powers!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Look at this jet-black and gold ornamentation...!
Doesn't it look just like the night sky and the moon?"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Grandma told me: "Black is a strong, free color
that can never be tainted by anything else."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's why black is a witch's color.
I won't let myself be dyed by anything either!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"And the witch uses magic bathed in the moonlight!
Incredible magic that can do anything at all♪"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"This outfit is packed full of other magical powers too!
As long as I'm wearing this, nothing is impossible!"
choice_data_list: I see, that explains the change of clothes.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, get it now?
You've gotten a little wiser as a familiar.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's pull ourselves together... Here goes!
Come back to me, "Callistephus aster" pen!
(Deaaaaad silence............)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ngh~~~~~! Whyyyy!?
This racing outfit is supposed to be invincibleeee!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No no no, no waaaaay~~~~~!
I know for absolute sure something's gotta happen!

choice_data_list: (What was that loud noise just now...!?)

text_block_list.text:
Looking down, Sweep Tosho's tantrum had bent the gutter grate,
making the gap even wider...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Looks like my hand could fit in here, don't you think?
Let's see...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hah... Alley-oop! I got it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yay!
Looks like the magic had a delayed effect!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: That was wonderful magic! Thank you so much, Sweep-sanâª

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, what a hasty one you are♪
All you have to do is put it back!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hnnngh!
Princess Barehanded Preeeess!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Amazing!
It's back to normal in the blink of an eye!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's just how amazing I am!
Looks like I even powered up Kawakami's strength♪
choice_data_list: I-Is this the power of magic too...?!
The witch and the princess make a great combo, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Heheh♪ Isn't it obvious?!
This is the power of the genius magical girl, Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks to that lovely magic,
everything's turned out just splendidly, hasn't it!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Naturally, right? A witch is supposed to help a princess with magic, after all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes♪ A princess grows crazy strong through her passionate friendship with a witch, after all~!
